expo.name: iaLingo

infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: iaLingo recognizes your child's spoken English on this device so it can give friendly pronunciation feedback. Audio is not stored or shared.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: iaLingo uses the microphone only while your child practices speaking. Speech is recognized on this device; nothing is uploaded, and voice diary recordings are saved only if a grown-up turns them on.

plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: iaLingo recognizes your child's spoken English on this device so it can give friendly pronunciation feedback. Audio is not stored or shared.

android.extraProguardRules:
# expo-gl ships no R8 rules. Expo creates GLView by reflection (it is a TextureView, not an
# ExpoView, so expo-modules-core's rule misses it) and the native side calls GLContext.flush()
# by name over JNI. Without this, every 3D screen crashes in release builds (Play rejection, 2026-11-08).
-keep class expo.modules.gl.** { *; }

expo.description: Learn English with magical pets. No login, no ads, no data collection: everything stays on the device.
